text:
Sophia Chen: FYI incoming customer ask — wants a per-customer 'instruct' variant from base-7b, 32k context, custom tokenizer tweaks, and INT4 quant. They want latency ~150ms/token and dedicated pool. Can we intake and prioritize?
Kevin Li: what's the SLA + expected QPS?
Mike Turner: enterprise customer, ready to sign for dedicated. Priority = high. Will coordinate billing & contract.
Anita Rodriguez: I'll own the ML intake. Need exact failure mode tolerance for hallucinations and regeneration policy. Also: will this require safety tuning / deletions?
Sophia Chen: Good point — they flagged stricter safety on finance content. They want an instruct head with conservative decoding + response length cap.
Anita Rodriguez: Ok. Initial checklist I propose:
```
- HF conversion & tokenizer sanity check
- Baseline eval on openeval + customer prompt set
- INT8 sanity then INT4 sweep with calibration set
- Long-context KV memory tests to 32k
- Latency perf runs on dedicated droplet
- Canary rollout + rollback plan
```
Kevin Li: add "memory usage under batch pressure" to perf tests. Also include fallback to base-7b-quantized if instruct variant regresses.
Sophia Chen: linking internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-onboard (private).
Anita Rodriguez: Quant command I'll use for the initial sweep:
```bash
python tools/quantize.py --model hf://base-7b --to int4 --calibrate --calibset data/custA_calib.json \
  --out models/base-7b-custA-int4
```
Mike Turner: Ops note — customer expects dedicated capacity within 2 weeks. Can infra meet that?
Kevin Li: tagging infra team separately but preliminary: yes if we reserve 2xA100 for dev + canary. I'll open a capacity ticket.
infra-bot: Deployment ticket created: INFRA-1298 assigned to eng-infra. Template: `dedicated/gpu-reserve/v1`.
Anita Rodriguez: I'll run baseline evals tomorrow and post a short summary with pass/fail on hallucination and safety thresholds. If INT4 fails quality, we'll try mixed-precision (INT8/FP16) fallback.
Sophia Chen: Thanks — please post the prioritize/estimate in this thread so PM can update roadmap. :thumbsup:
